title: Multi-step 'the way there' directions for hold-quest locations (e.g. 'one south, then one east, then out, then six west') required frequent backtracking and repeated free 'get your bearings' checks to navigate sprawling wilderness maps (Thornwold's wood, the Iron Downs, Wardmoor's moor); room names rarely hinted at the target, so wrong turns were common.
